note: DC subset split on CD11c × CD123 within HLADR+ Lin- CD14- CD16- CD56- compartment. pDC: plasmacytoid dendritic cells — large cloud at CD123 high forming a horizontal band at the top of the plot (spans a broad CD11c range). mDC: myeloid dendritic cells — main cluster at the right (CD11c high, CD123 mid-to-high). CD11cpos_CD123pos: CD11c+ CD123+ residual (very small group). CD11cneg_CD123neg: CD11c- CD123- residual — sparse cluster at the left.
tips: DC subsetting on CD11c × CD123 quadrants. pDC: CD11c- CD123+ (CD123 high). mDC: CD11c+ CD123 dim/low (CD123 lower than pDC; not necessarily absolutely negative — the cut is relative within HLA-DR+ DCs). CD11cpos_CD123pos: CD11c+ CD123+. CD11cneg_CD123neg: CD11c- CD123-. Naming caveat: the four categories mix biological names (`pDC`, `mDC`) with explicit marker-signature names (`CD11cpos_CD123pos`, `CD11cneg_CD123neg`) — this is intentional, reflecting that only the two canonical DC subsets have well-defined biological identities at this resolution.
